**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** [Current Date]  
**To:** [Ordering Provider]  
**Re:** Laparoscopic Adjustable Gastric Banding (CPT 43770)  
**Patient:** [Patient Name] | **Order Date:** April 20, 2025

---

**DECISION: APPROVED**

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding is approved.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Most recent BMI on 3/13/2025 is 35.0 kg/m², meeting the minimum threshold of 35 or greater.

**Obesity-Related Co-morbidities:** Met. Patient has documented active Type 2 diabetes mellitus (E11.9) and obstructive sleep apnea (G47.33), both recognized obesity-related conditions.

**Prior Conservative Treatment:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after medication discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. CPT code 43770 (laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding) is a covered bariatric procedure.

---

**Authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter date.** Please contact us if you have questions or need additional information.
